rationale: The massing reads as a coherent stepped array with a clear dominant platform gesture in all views, and the top/front/isometric projections stay consistent rather than collapsing into a single-view trick. The primary and secondary pieces are legible, with the void/courtyard logic present but still somewhat shallow and more diagrammatic than strongly public. The silhouette depends on shifting stacked slabs, but not overwhelmingly on stair-step profile alone. There is minor fragmentation and some surface segmentation, yet the volumes do not visibly collide across views, so the form remains repairable and reasonably coherent. Precedent resonance is strongest with stacked-shifted platforms and nested/clustered massing rather than the torqued tower reference.
warnings: Void is present but not yet fully expressed as an active public undercut/courtyard.
Some surface articulation reads as multiple clipped pieces rather than one settled aggregate mass.
